test_prompts_create: test the TestPrompts class to create prompts via POST /api/v1/prompts/create with command, title, and content
test_prompts_list: test the TestPrompts class to list all prompts via GET /api/v1/prompts/ endpoint
test_prompts_get_by_command: test the TestPrompts class to retrieve a single prompt by command via GET /api/v1/prompts/command/{command}
test_prompts_update: test the TestPrompts class to update a prompt via POST /api/v1/prompts/command/{command}/update with new title and content
test_prompts_delete: test the TestPrompts class to delete a prompt via DELETE /api/v1/prompts/command/{command}/delete
